text:
nina: hey all, just joined and hitting onboarding VPN issues. company Mac M1, installed WireGuard via Okta, tunnel says connected but none of the 10.42.x services resolve (internal-registry, prometheus). ssh to bastion times out too. any fast tips?

raj: welcome! first quick check: `wg show` and `ifconfig utun0` pls. also `scutil --dns` to confirm DNS is pushed. sometimes our MDM blocks route pushes.

nina: `wg show` shows handshake and peer, allowedips = 10.42.0.0/16,0.0.0.0/0. `ifconfig utun0` exists but no 10.42 route in `netstat -rn`. `scutil --dns` only lists ISP DNS.

raj: yup, looks like the WireGuard daemon connected but osx didn't install the routes. Two quick workarounds: 1) start an ssh jump proxy and use ProxyJump for git/ssh. e.g. `ssh -J nina@bastion.corp.redwood.com git@internal:repo.git` or add `ProxyJump bastion.corp.redwood.com` in `~/.ssh/config`. 2) if you need browser/GUI access, run `ssh -D 1080 -p 443 nina@bastion.corp.redwood.com` and point browser to `socks5://localhost:1080`.

nina: can't reach bastion either, port 22 times out. tried `-p 443` as well.

raj: hmm. two possibilities: home ISP blocking outbound on 443 for non-HTTPS, or our firewall hasn't seen your public IP yet. can you paste `curl ifconfig.me`? also check if your home router has IPv6 prefer — sometimes that breaks our policy.

nina: my public IP is 73.201.45.12. curl shows IPv4.

infra-oncall: thanks @nina — filing a temporary allow for 73.201.45.12 to the bastion security group now (ticket INFRA-9983). if you still can't connect after a minute, post the `traceroute -T -p 443 bastion.corp.redwood.com` output.

it-bot: device enrollment status: nina's device not yet "okta-approved-device". MDM policy `restrict-route-push` is active; until approved the system will ignore network-scripts. To speed up, approve the device in Okta or request IT to push the tag.

michael: FYI if MDM blocks route pushes you can (temporary) add routes locally with sudo: `sudo route -nv add -net 10.42.0.0/16 -interface utun0` — this is ephemeral (reboots/ifconfig changes wipe it). use only if comfortable with sudo.

nina: tried manual route add, `route` errors with "SIOCADDRT: Operation not permitted" — looks like MDM denies even manual route changes.

raj: ok that's consistent with `restrict-route-push`. two paths: 1) IT approves device in Okta/MDM (best), 2) we ship you a temporary laptop or hotspot that we can whitelist. @infra-oncall do we have spare loaners?

infra-oncall: we have a loaner pool. opened LOANER-324 and assigned to infra-eng for shipping. ETA 2 business days. in parallel we approved a temporary bastion allow for nina's IP and pushed a ticket to device-ops to expedite Okta approval.

nina: thank you! for now I'm using my phone's hotspot — mobile IP works and I can connect to bastion and the internal dashboard. opened INFRA-9983 with details.

michael: great workaround. once device is Okta-approved the WireGuard profile will install routes automatically and you won't need the hotspot. reach out if you want me to DM the quick checklist for first-week network setup.

nina: appreciate it everyone — feeling much less blocked. :relieved:
